document_info.file_name: 38. SPKS - Farmers asked for simplified requirements.pdf

extracted_stakeholders.name: National Palm Oil Farmers Union (SPKS)
extracted_stakeholders.role: Represents palm oil farmers and advocates for improved conditions and requirements in the PSR program.

extracted_stakeholders.name: Sabarudin
extracted_stakeholders.role: General Chairperson of SPKS, advocating for increased PSR funding and simplified requirements.

extracted_stakeholders.name: Indonesian Palm Oil Plantation Fund Management Agency (BPDPKS)
extracted_stakeholders.role: Manages funds for the People's Oil Palm Rejuvenation (PSR) program and sets requirements.

extracted_stakeholders.name: Ministry of Agrarian Affairs and Spatial Planning/National Land Agency (ATR/BPN)
extracted_stakeholders.role: Provides land status recommendations required for PSR eligibility.

extracted_stakeholders.name: Ministry of Environment and Forestry (Kementerian KLHK)
extracted_stakeholders.role: Issues recommendations regarding land cultivation outside of peat and forest areas.

extracted_stakeholders.name: President Prabowo
extracted_stakeholders.role: Receives appreciation from palm oil farmers for support on farmer debts.

extracted_factors.Label: Increase in PSR Funds
extracted_factors.Description: The increase in the People's Oil Palm Rejuvenation funds to 60 million per hectare aims to meet the financial needs for rejuvenation. This change impacts the stakeholders by providing more resources to small farmers.

extracted_factors.Label: Access Difficulty for PSR Program
extracted_factors.Description: Current PSR program requirements are perceived as difficult by farmers, particularly the need for recommendations from ATR/BPN and Kementerian KLHK. This factor affects farmers who struggle to meet these requirements.

extracted_factors.Label: Regulation Revision Request
extracted_factors.Description: Sabarudin and SPKS urge revisions to Minister of Agriculture Regulation Number 03 of 2022, aiming to ease burdensome requirements on farmers, which could change how rules apply to stakeholders.

extracted_factors.Label: CPO Export Ban Lifting
extracted_factors.Description: The lifting of the CPO export ban has influenced the price of palm fresh fruit bunches, impacting the income of independent oil palm farmers.
